# UIkit (vendored)

The documentation site ships UIkit itself; it is never loaded from a CDN.

- Version: 3.25.26
- Source: <https://github.com/uikit/uikit/releases/download/v3.25.26/uikit-3.25.26.zip>
- SHA-256 of the release archive: `81a55daff096995dc2e67944d08302b5530e577cc6782534a69ca068a0b094ef`
- Files taken unchanged from the archive: `css/uikit.min.css`, `js/uikit.min.js`, `js/uikit-icons.min.js`
- License: MIT, see [LICENSE.md](LICENSE.md)

To update, download the new release archive from the UIkit GitHub releases, check its SHA-256, replace the three
files, and update the version and checksum above. Site-specific styles live in `../../css/`, never in these files.
